title: Independent verification of the live horizon — 2026-11-19
rule: Every value below is either read first-hand from an official NBA page on 2026-11-19 through the fetch channel and compared with what this repository publishes, or computed by this script from repository files with the computation stated. Nothing is transcribed from memory, inferred, or filled in.
sandbox_note: this sandbox cannot open a TLS connection to www.nba.com (curl exits 35, SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL); official reads were made through the platform fetch channel. Byte-exact PDF capture needs an Actions runner and is out of this seat's scope.

flagged.title: Three horizon rows print the wrong record for two teams
flagged.detail: LAL is printed 13-2 where the official standings say 13-3; UTA is printed 2-13 where they say 3-13. All 26 game ids and all 26 tip times match the official scoreboards, so the schedule is right and the defect is confined to the records column. The model does not read this column, so no line moved because of it.
flagged.severity: cosmetic to the model, material to a reader

flagged.title: Two different published records for the same strategy
flagged.detail: README.md headlines S1 as 23-9 worth +11.91 units; docs/data/leaderboard.json carries S1 as 23-8 worth +12.909 units, LBS 82.0, n_graded 31. The two numbers differ by a game and by a unit. Neither can be reproduced from data/settlement/**, because the settlement files grade tickets, not strategies.
flagged.severity: material - the leaderboard is the competition scoreboard

flagged.title: The strategy ledger is six days stale and predates 25 settled picks
flagged.detail: data/derived/strategies.json is generated_utc 2026-11-13, lists 8 strategies and states 'the largest graded set is 14 bets'. The repository now holds 5 settled slates and 39 published singles (14-23-1). docs/data/leaderboard.json lists 10 strategies, so the two registers also disagree on how many strategies exist.

flagged.title: Lines were priced off an injury edition five revisions old
flagged.detail: The official index read at 07:16Z lists eight editions for 2026-11-19, the newest 01:45 AM ET. data/derived/horizon_lines.json names 12:30 AM ET as its injury input. First tip is 8:00 PM ET, so five revisions exist that no published line reflects.
flagged.severity: material for any bet-surface use; that surface is gated closed

flagged.title: Three games of the 26 move by more than a point when repriced with the current official table
flagged.detail: The official advanced table has now absorbed the 11/18 UTA 109 @ LAL 97 game, which the repo's cut predates (its own flag F-929-01 records the lag). Repricing with the model's own published formula moves PHX@UTA by +1.21 on the spread and -1.34 on the total, SAC@LAL by -1.41 and -2.19, DAL@UTA by +1.20 and -1.35. The other 23 games move by 0.05 point or less. The defect is exactly the two teams the file already flags, and it is now measurable in points rather than described as a lag.
flagged.severity: material - those three lines are stale by more than a point

flagged.title: WITHDRAWN - a suspected missing page that measured clean
flagged.detail: This seat briefly believed scripts/build_dashboard.py built no site/pages/strategies.html while the nav linked to it. Measured afterwards on this tree: the builder writes it at line 2394, the file exists, all 39 nav page entries exist on disk, and every external nav target resolves. The belief was wrong and is recorded rather than deleted, because this seat's own claims get the same scrutiny as the data. No defect existed and nothing was fixed.

adoption_requests.request: Re-cut the PHX@UTA, SAC@LAL and DAL@UTA lines from the current advanced table, or print the reading timestamp and the GP of each input beside each line.
Publish one S1 record with its derivation, or publish none.
Regenerate the strategy register from data/settlement/** so strategy count and records come from settled tickets instead of a 2026-11-13 cut.

This seat publishes site/pages/live-horizon.html and site/pages/decision-register.html from a namespaced builder rather than editing scripts/build_dashboard.py, which PR #181's tree also touches. Wire them into the shared navigation when that branch lands.
Gate the rebuild on injury-edition currency as well as freshness: a line whose injury basis is older than the newest index edition should be marked, not published as current.
